# authsignal_passkey_authenticator_configuration (Resource)

Manages the tenant's passkey authenticator configuration. Destroying the resource deletes the configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "authsignal_passkey_authenticator_configuration" "passkey" {
  relying_party = "example.com"

  expected_origins = [
    "https://example.com",
    "https://app.example.com",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `expected_origins` (Set of String) Allowed web or Android origins. Each must begin with `http://`, `https://`, or `android:`.
- `relying_party` (String) The relying party domain passkeys are scoped to, without a URL scheme.

### Optional

- `authenticator_attachment` (String) Which kinds of authenticator the browser may offer. One of `all-supported`, `cross-platform`, `platform`.
- `is_active` (Boolean)
- `passkey_registration_hints` (List of String) Ordered browser hints for preferred authenticator types. Set to `[]` to clear them. Each element is one of `client-device`, `hybrid`, or `security-key`.
- `user_verification_requirement` (String) Whether the authenticator must verify the user, rather than only proving possession. One of `preferred`, `required`.

### Read-Only

- `authenticator_id` (String)
- `verification_method` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import authsignal_passkey_authenticator_configuration.passkey passkey
```
